blocks.text: MANILA – The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) has raised the maximum Christmas cash gift for pensioners from P10,000 to P15,000, set for release on December 1. In a video posted to the agency’s official Facebook page, GSIS President and General Manager Wick Veloso unveiled the higher cash gift alongside an earlier release date for […]...
